# Usher

> Usher is a demo football ticket reservation app: browse fictional fixtures, pick Standard, Student or Senior tickets and reserve instantly. No payment is taken.

- [Usher](https://usher.piotrkrzysztof.dev/): browse upcoming fictional fixtures and reserve tickets.
- [Help](https://usher.piotrkrzysztof.dev/help): how booking, ticket types, reservations and accounts work.
- [About](https://usher.piotrkrzysztof.dev/about): what Usher is, who built it and where to find the source.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/straightchlorine/usher): Go API and React front end.
- [Documentation](https://docs.usher.piotrkrzysztof.dev): how Usher is built and run.
- [Piotr's site](https://piotrkrzysztof.dev): more projects.
